name: page-audit-tool
title: SEO Audit and Accessibility Crawler: Alt Text, Meta Tags, Headings
description: Give it a domain and it crawls the site page by page, with no sitemap, returning one row per page with twelve technical SEO and HTML accessibility defects: status, title, meta description, h1 count, heading order, alt text, form labels, canonical. An automated audit does not attest WCAG conformity.

page-audited.eventDescription: Charged once for each page row written to the dataset: an HTML page that answered with a 2xx status and was checked for title, meta description, canonical tag, heading order, image alt text and form labels. HTTP errors, non-HTML files, redirects without content and pages blocked by robots.txt are never charged, and the same page under two URL spellings is charged once.

site-report.eventDescription: The summary report for the whole run: totals per problem type and the worst pages. Charged once per run, only when at least one page was audited.
